title: Letter 1
text: Hello love, I wish I had started this when you first left but I got this idea right now so here we are. I love you so deeply and hope you're having so much fun in texas.

title: Letter 2
text: Hello love, HAPPY 6 MONTH MEETIVERSARY. Who knew that day would be the best domino effect of all time. What attracted me the most to you that day was how outgoing and passionate you were in our conversation. I went home and layed in my bed smiling for like 2 hours and you've made me feel like that everyday since. I love you rif!

title: Letter 3
text: Hello love, HAPPY GIRLFRIENDS DAY RAHHHHH. It pained me to pretend like I forgot whilst I was being too lazy to open my laptop. Anyways I love you and thank you for making me so happy to have a girlfriend on girlfriends day. Wish I could be celebrating you in person. Love and miss you so deeply rif

title: Letter 4
text: Hello love, Sorry this took longer than past days, the couch rot got me. I hope you had so much fun in Texas, I'm so glad you are back in the bay so we can talk more I miss you sm. PS: we survived our first week, only 7 more to go!

title: Letter 5
text: Hello love, Sorry this took even longer than yesterday. I still do hope you see this. I had so much fun facetiming last night and it made me sad afterwards because I missed you so much but it was awesome to hear your voice again. Thank you for dealing with my tweekout right now, it was unwarranted and im sorry if I worried you. I love you and thank you for putting up with me

title: Letter 6
text: Hello love, HAPPY 4 MONTH ANNIVERSARY YAYYYYY. The last 4 months have been the best 4 months of my life. You've shown me how wonderful it is to be loved by somebody else. You're always there for me and I appreciate you so much. You're not just my lover, you're not just my partner, you're my best friend on top of all those other things. You're the girl I wanna share every aspect of my life with and I just want you to know how special you are to me. Love you rif!

title: Letter 7
text: Hello love, TWO DAYS UNTIL YOUR BIRTHDAY YAYYYYYYYYY. Are you so excited? I hope you are because I'm gonna be in a state of whimsy all day just knowing its your birthday. In fact I'm actually gonna take the day off in #solidarity. This is officially the longest we've been apart since we met. I miss and love you so much rif

title: Letter 8
text: Hello love, sorry this is super late, I hope you loved the spiderman movie and cant wait to hear you tell me all about it. ITS ALMOST YOUR BIRTHDAY WOOOOO. I think im more excited for your birthday then I've been for any of my birthdays since my childhood. I love you so much and you deserve everything good your 20's has to offer. I love you rif

title: Letter 9
text: Hello love, HAPPY BIRTHDAY AHHHHHHHHH. Its literally your birthday and thats just so crazy because I have an execuse to celebrate you even more and I love that. I hope this day is everything you want it to be and I hope your 20's make you just as happy as you make me. You're my best friend and I can't wait to spend my twenties on you (look that up). I LOVE YOU RIF HAPPY BIRTHDAY

title: Letter 10
text: Hello love, Happy Day 10 of letter writing. We're much closer than you think to seeing each other again. 2 of the 8 weeks will have already passed tmr, yayyyyy. I love you so much rif and hope you had a lot of fun at dinner. I miss you!

title: Letter 11
text: Hello love, We're officially 25% of the way there but I'm especially missing you today, I really wish you were here in my arms. Missing you a little extra today babe I love you!

title: Letter 12
text: Hello love, Happy Week 3 baby, I really miss you a lot. You're almost half way through summer school yay!. We're doing so well and we just need to come. I love you a lot and I just catch myself reminiscing about our time together I can't wait for that feeling of seeing you everyday to come back.

title: Letter 13
text: Hello love, I hope your period doesn't cause you so much pain. Our conversation last night genuinely helped me so much. I've known you're the one for me for a long time but its moments like that where I'm certain you are my soulmate. I love you so so much you dont even get it. You've lifted me up a lot in the last 14 hours and I appreciate you so much for it, thank you baby I love you

title: Letter 14
text: Hello love, Im facetiming you right now so this will be a small one, unlike other things that arent small. Love and miss you my beautiful amazing queen.

title: Letter 15
text: Hello love, HAPPY 7 MONTH INSTAVERSARY YAYYYYYY. 7 months ago today, the most beautiful girl in the entire world. I love you so deeply with my entire heart. Last nights conversation brought me back to how we used to stay up until 4am and text so attentively and it was just so amazing. I love you more than life itself my wonderful soulmate, good luck on your midterm my love!
